claims.text:
stage computation: Four binary inputs. Fixed local detectors h1=ReLU(x0+x1−1), h2=ReLU(x2+x3−1); high output H=ReLU(h1+h2−1). Input1111 gives h=[1,1], H1. Input1100 gives h=[1,0], H0; input1011 gives[0,1], H0. Display actual sums, thresholds and connected receptive fields.

**Countercase / boundary:** The weights/thresholds are declared, not learned. A low detector firing does not by itself activate the conjunction. Flip x0 in1111 to0: h1 drops0 and H0, showing dependency rather than a generic later-layer “object” label.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether1100 activates the high unit; recall0111 activates only the right local detector and leaves H0.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Toggle one input at a time through semantic44px controls; primary1111 and current intermediate/output states retained together. Do not attribute a real semantic feature or training history to these units.
